rationale.overall: A and B share the same cast/tile composition, but B’s softer, more diffuse surface light sits slightly closer to the REFERENCE’s volumetric read, so it takes the overall match.
rationale.material: B’s highlight falloff on the white shell and coral face is gentler and less pin-sharp than A’s, nearer the REFERENCE’s frosted translucency and soft internal glow.
rationale.silhouette: Both preserve the same dimetric mould-and-tile outline and coral face mark as each other, with no meaningful contour difference at 1024.
rationale.smallsize: The 128/32/16 strips stay effectively interchangeable: the coral wedge carries the read and the stepped glyph collapses the same way by 16px.
